addressed_to.description: For a tax invoice: addressed to the company (the default), or to the claimant as its agent.

amount.description: What the receipt shows was paid, including GST, in its currency.

attendees.description: Who attended, for a meal or entertainment.
examples: Mei Ling Tan; Tan Wei, Acme

category_id.description: The expense policy's category it is for: the account it costs (FR-AP-15).

date.description: The receipt's date: its rate and its GST treatment are read on it.

document.description: What the receipt is, for its input tax (FR-AP-20): a tax invoice (the default), a simplified tax invoice (the merchant's GST number, no customer named), or none.

fx_rate.description: For a receipt in another currency, a rate into the base currency typed by the claimant; left out, the rate on its date (ENG-40).

gst.description: The GST the receipt shows, in its currency; none when left out.

gst_code.description: The receipt's GST code for purchases, from the sg-gst pack: TX when it shows GST, NR when the merchant is not GST-registered, OP outside Singapore.

kind.description: receipt: what was bought, as the receipt shows it (the default). Mileage lines arrive with the mileage rates (FR-AP-16).

merchant.description: Who was paid, as the receipt shows it.

paid.description: For a receipt in another currency: what left the claimant's account in the base currency, as their card statement shows it; what the company owes them for it (FR-AP-17). Left out: the amount at the rate on its date.

stated_gst.description: For a receipt in another currency: the GST its tax invoice states in the base currency (ENG-42); without it the GST is not claimed.
